## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger and what changes for the user or operator.

## Validation

List relevant checks and results. Explain skipped integration checks.

## Risks and rollout

Mention migrations, rollback constraints, dependency/config changes and remaining limitations when applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] Documentation and feature status reflect the change.
- [ ] Financial, ownership, approval and idempotency invariants are preserved.
- [ ] No secrets, customer records or local caches are included.
- [ ] Appropriate tests or manual evidence are included.
